title: Technology
description: The platform behind every Pronix deal — from SPV structuring to quarterly distributions.
section1Body: Every property sits inside a dedicated legal entity. Ownership claims map directly to Albanian land registry records — not off-register promises.
section2Body: Reserve, sign, and track your ownership online. Paper where the law requires it; digital everywhere else.
section3Body: Rent flows in, expenses are deducted, and net yield is distributed on a fixed schedule — whether you own the whole building or a single share.
section4Body: Tell it your budget, timeline, and goals. Get matched properties with projected returns, instantly.
section5Body: Ask anything about a property, the market, or how co-ownership works. Real answers from real deal data.
section6Body: Track every share, every distribution, every document — in one place.
section7Body: Albanian, English, or Italian. The platform answers in the language you use.
